title: Coconut Development Board Various Post Recruitment 2026
summary: Coconut Development Board (CDB), Kochi , has released a Notification on its official website for the recruitment of Deputy Director, Assistant Director, Administrative Officer, Accounts Officer, Data Entry Operator, Lower Division Clerk (LDC) & Other Various Posts . This recruitment is being conducted for 35 vacancies. The Coconut Development Board Application Form has started on 25 November 2026 & the candidates can apply until 21 December 2026 . The Minimum age required is N/A & The Maximum Age Is 27 – 40 Years as on 21 December 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Coconut Development Board Various Post Recruitment 2026 which are given below. ( Advt No : 02/2026 )
qualification: Candidates must have passed 12th Intermediate From Any Recognized Board in India. Typing On Computer (English : 35 wpm / Hindi : 30 wpm)
